A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of Wood — the lord of the Wood House of the Carbon Nation. A female character who IS that substance; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the substance’s traits, within the element’s own palette. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.

1. STYLE
A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance.
Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described below.

2. CHARACTER
Age: late twenties — a clear adult face with soft, smooth contours; no wrinkles, folds or under-eye bags.
Face — her own: a rugged, tough, outdoorsy look; deep brown skin; delicate V-line face with a small, soft chin; phoenix eyes with gracefully lifted outer corners, of natural size; emerald-green eyes; thin straight brows; petite straight nose; soft medium lips.
Body and hair: curvy build; a coiled low chignon with short curled temple strands; cedar-brown hair.
Expression: a relaxed, unforced face, lips gently closed.
Her element, carried in her design: two faces of one element: black soot and clear diamond; hexagonal lattices (graphite, graphene) as patterns, pencil-graphite grey, carbon-fibre weave; it bonds with everything and is the frame of all life.
Her house, carried in her design: wood as worked material: planed timber with visible grain and growth rings, paper and scrolls, coopered barrels, carved joints and curls of sawdust; warm honey browns, pale birch and dark walnut with ink black; the shaped, made side of carbon.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — MECHA
Costume: she is a female mecha personification — plates, joints, binders and glow lines carry the traits above; the plates must read as solid armor with visible joints, not as cloth or a gown; a back unit may carry the motif. Matte carbon-fibre weave armor with hexagonal lattice panels, diamond-clear visor and joint crystals, graphite-grey plates, a thin hexagonal halo.
Silhouette: one long segmented mechanical tail reaching from the back of her waist, tipped with a weapon or ornament. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the element's materials and palette.
Design idea: Interlocking mortise-and-tenon wooden ribs join the shoulder and hip structures, exposing pale birch end grain against walnut layers.
Colours: charcoal black, graphite grey, diamond white, a single living green.
House colours: honey oak, walnut brown, pale birch, ink black.
Exposure (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — bare shoulders and upper arms between pauldron and gauntlet, and a deep open chest window with natural cleavage framed by the chest plates; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: year 2200, a city of graphene towers: hexagonal lattice facades, carbon-fibre weave surfaces, diamond-glass bridges.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Stance and hands: both empty hands relaxed naturally at her sides, fingers clearly separated.
Setting detail: a timber joinery pavilion integrated into the world described above, with carefully carved wooden beams.
Light: the scene's own light, rendered the way this style renders light and skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (C) and atomic number (6) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face, plastic 3D-render finish.
